title: Thyroid Dysfunction and Cognitive Impairment: Neural Mechanisms and Neurofeedback‐Based Interventions
abstract: ABSTRACT Background Thyroid dysfunction has emerged as a significant contributor to global public health challenges, with mounting evidence indicating its impact on cognitive function. Methods The current literature was synthesized to examine the association between thyroid dysfunction and cognitive impairments, the underlying neural mechanisms, and potential therapeutic approaches. Results A critical gap identified in this review is the incomplete understanding of the neural mechanisms underlying thyroid‐related cognitive decline, which hampers the development of targeted interventions. Conclusion Neurofeedback is examined as a potential therapeutic approach for cognitive rehabilitation, and future research directions are proposed to advance this field.
